meta.caveat: These decisions review source-native issue placement into citizen buckets; they do not review every actor entry inside each issue.

cluster_definitions.reviewed_label: Autonomia territorial, administracion local y reformas institucionales
cluster_definitions.rationale: Bucket covers autonomy statutes, local-government rules, and institutional reform issues not captured by existing keyword buckets.
cluster_definitions.caveat: Issue placement is reviewed for this seed batch only; future similar issues need explicit review or better rules.

cluster_definitions.reviewed_label: Regimen sancionador, inspeccion y potestad administrativa
cluster_definitions.rationale: Bucket covers sanctioning, inspection, and administrative enforcement regimes across policy domains.
cluster_definitions.caveat: This bucket groups legal/enforcement responsibility evidence; domain-specific secondary tags remain useful.
